About the job

Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?




We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we’ve become the world’s largest D2C sleep brand, available in over 35 countries with more than 25 stores across Europe. Recommended by leading consumer associations in EMEA, APAC, and the Americas, we develop the best sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. 

 

At Emma, we are a community of smart, driven people, united by a strong culture of collaboration, teamwork, and knowledge sharing. We think big, take ownership, and are empowered to drive meaningful impact. Through hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning, we drive our own growth and learning. With Emmies from over 60 nationalities and offices across multiple regions, our diverse perspectives enrich our workplace culture. Ready to shape the future of sleep with us? Let’s make it happen!




What you will do:


Support the strategy team in analyzing marketplace performance and identifying growth opportunities


Help coordinate between our marketing and marketplace teams to ensure campaigns align with pricing and promotions


Assist in testing new marketplace initiatives and sharing feedback with the team


Monitor inventory constantly across all platforms


Review pricing offers to ensure accuracy and competitive positioning


Upload prices to each marketplace platform


Download and analyze weekly sales results and P&L data


Fill out marketplace tracking reports


Create weekly presentations of marketplace performance


Update unit economics monthly








What we are looking for:


Recent graduate (any major welcome)


Strong attention to detail


Comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic data


Curious and willing to ask questions


Good communication skills


Spanish and English fluent








What we offer:


Food vouchers


Hybrid home office policy (60-40)


Pet-friendly office


A combination of personal and company growth to accelerate your career and help you reach your goals


The chance to work on exciting and challenging projects either independently or as part of a dedicated, international team


Responsibility and decision-making authority from day one—you'll create an impact with new, innovative ideas and help shape our company DNA











Become an Emmie




Emma is transforming the world of sleep - and we want the highest-performing people to help us pull it off. We want you. But only if you're willing to go all in. Only if you're willing to question, disrupt, innovate, and create from the ground up. 




We proudly celebrate diversity. We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting inclusion in our workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.




Our aim is to get back to you in a couple of days, however, we are currently receiving a large number of applications and this might lead to a delay in the process. We will get back to you as soon as possible! 




Upon your consent, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as get the interviews transcript and summarised by AI. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to privacy@emma-sleep.com

Para nuestra compañía de Internships, buscamos un Recruitment and Marketing Intern proactivo, organizado y creativo que apoye en la atracción, seguimiento y comunicación con estudiantes interesados en realizar prácticas profesionales en el extranjero.

La posición colaborará en actividades de prospección, seguimiento de leads, actualización del CRM, creación de contenido, campañas digitales y coordinación de eventos universitarios. Tendrá contacto con estudiantes, universidades y participantes del programa Ambassadors, contribuyendo al crecimiento y posicionamiento de Worldwide Internships.

Buscamos a un estudiante con excelentes habilidades de comunicación, organización y atención al detalle, que tenga interés en desarrollarse en áreas de reclutamiento, ventas, marketing y coordinación de eventos.

Revisar y actualizar bases de datos de contactos, incluyendo universidades, alumnos y partners.
Dar seguimiento a leads generados por marketing y eventos.
Apoyar en el envío de correos, mensajes de WhatsApp y seguimiento de estudiantes interesados.
Dar seguimiento a participantes actuales y potenciales del programa Ambassadors.
Documentar las interacciones con leads y estudiantes en el CRM.
Apoyar en la creación de contenido para redes sociales y campañas digitales.
Colaborar en el diseño de publicaciones dirigidas a estudiantes y universidades.
Analizar el engagement y los resultados de campañas, generando insights y propuestas de mejora.
Dar soporte en la planificación y logística de eventos presenciales y virtuales.
Apoyar en la elaboración de reportes sobre asistencia y efectividad de los eventos.




Perfil buscado:




Estudiante activo de Marketing, Comunicación, Administración, Negocios Internacionales, Turismo o una carrera relacionada.
Excelente comunicación escrita y verbal en inglés y español.
Organización, atención al detalle y capacidad para dar seguimiento a diferentes actividades.
Disponibilidad de lunes a viernes, de 8:00 a. m. a 2:00 p. m.
Experiencia previa en servicio al cliente, ventas, reclutamiento, marketing o eventos, deseable.
Manejo de herramientas de creación de contenido, deseable.
Conocimiento básico de redes sociales y campañas digitales.
Experiencia académica o profesional en el extranjero, deseable.

description:
About the job

About Smart Capital Center

Smart Capital Center is an AI-powered platform built for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) investment and financial management in the U.S. market.

Our platform combines real-time data intelligence, workflow automation, and AI-driven insights to support underwriting, asset management, and portfolio analytics for institutional real estate firms.

We operate at the intersection of AI, finance, and commercial real estate, helping investment teams work faster, make smarter decisions, and scale operations more efficiently.

As we continue growing, we are looking for a highly capable Marketing Specialist to help expand our digital presence, strengthen brand visibility, and support content and growth initiatives across multiple channels.




The Opportunity

This is a hands-on marketing role for someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, creative, and excited to work in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

You will work closely with leadership and operations teams to execute digital marketing initiatives, manage content workflows, improve online visibility, and support the company’s growth strategy.




This role is ideal for candidates who learn quickly, enjoy working with modern AI tools, and want to build real-world experience in technology-driven marketing operations.

We are looking for people who move fast, communicate clearly, take ownership, and consistently deliver high-quality work.




What You’ll Actually Do

Content & Social Media Management

Create, schedule, and publish content across multiple social media platforms
Maintain consistent brand messaging and professional communication standards
Support audience engagement, comments, and community interaction management
Coordinate content calendars and publishing schedules

SEO, GEO & Website Content

Develop SEO-optimized and GEO-aware content for blogs, landing pages, and website updates
Publish and maintain blog articles and marketing pages
Support keyword optimization, search visibility, and content performance initiatives
Assist with website content organization and updates

Digital Marketing & Brand Growth

Support ongoing marketing campaigns and visibility initiatives
Assist with online reputation building and brand positioning efforts
Support press release distribution and article publication workflows
Help identify opportunities for industry exposure and recognition

AI-Assisted Marketing Operations

Use AI tools to improve content production, workflow efficiency, research, and marketing execution
Continuously explore and adopt new AI-driven marketing workflows
Support automation and operational improvements across marketing functions

Reporting & Performance Tracking

Track content performance and engagement metrics
Prepare marketing reports and operational updates
Monitor growth trends and campaign performance across channels




Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for highly capable, execution-focused individuals who are proactive, adaptable, and eager to grow.

Requirements

Strong English communication skills (C1/C2 proficiency required)
Tech-savvy with strong digital literacy
Fast learner with a strong willingness to adopt new tools and systems
Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day workflows
Strong organizational and multitasking skills
Excellent attention to detail and execution quality
Ability to manage multiple content and marketing workflows simultaneously
Self-starter with strong ownership mentality
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-performance environment

Preferred Skills

Experience with social media management platforms
Familiarity with SEO and digital marketing concepts
Experience using AI tools for content creation, research, or workflow optimization
Basic experience with website content management systems is a plus
Experience with Canva, analytics tools, or content scheduling tools is a plus

This Role Is NOT For You If:

You struggle with organization and multitasking
You prefer slow-paced or highly structured environments
You are uncomfortable learning and adapting quickly
You are not comfortable using technology and AI tools regularly
You do not meet the English proficiency requirements

Please do not apply if you do not meet the core requirements.




What You’ll Gain

Real AI Workflow Experience

Learn how AI is used in modern marketing operations
Gain hands-on experience with AI-assisted content and automation workflows
Develop practical experience with next-generation marketing systems

Accelerated Skill Development

You will rapidly build experience in:

Digital marketing
SEO and content strategy
Social media operations
AI-assisted workflows
Brand building
Marketing analytics and reporting
Content operations and execution

High Ownership & Career Growth

Work directly with leadership and decision-makers
Operate in a high-performance environment with real responsibility
Build valuable cross-functional experience in technology and marketing
Strong growth opportunities for high performers

Why Join Smart Capital Center?

Work at the intersection of AI, finance, and commercial real estate
Join a lean, ambitious, high-performance team
Contribute directly to a fast-growing technology company
Gain exposure to real-world AI-driven business operations
Learn faster than in traditional corporate environments




Interested?

If you are highly organized, tech-savvy, eager to learn, and excited about building modern marketing operations using AI-powered workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

Learn more at:

www.smartcapitalcenter.com

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About the job

Company Description

Zephyr Technologies is a regional franchise distributor of electronic components, dedicated to delivering top-tier service and building trust in every transaction. Through advanced automation and cutting-edge software, we optimize the supply chain for customers worldwide. Our mission goes beyond component delivery — we ensure the success and continuity of technology projects through strategic, reliable distribution solutions. Headquartered in Guadalajara, Mexico, Zephyr Technologies drives innovation and empowers the growth of our partners globally.




Role Description

This is a full-time hybrid role based in the Mexico City / Querétaro area. This position combines technical design expertise with active customer-facing sales responsibilities in an approximately 50/50 split. The Manager will serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients in the region — conducting on-site visits, understanding customer engineering needs, and translating them into design solutions and component recommendations. The role also involves leading internal engineering initiatives and collaborating closely with the sales team to close technically complex opportunities.




Responsibilities

Sales & Field Engineering (50%)

• Conduct on-site visits to clients and prospects in the assigned region to provide technical consultation and support

• Identify customer needs and propose tailored electronic component and design solutions

• Collaborate with the internal sales team to develop and close technical sales opportunities

• Build and maintain strong relationships with engineering and procurement contacts at key accounts

• Prepare and present technical proposals, quotations, and product recommendations

• Represent Zephyr Technologies at client meetings, industry events, and technical reviews

Design & Technical Engineering (50%)

• Design and develop printed circuit boards (PCBs) and review electronic schematics

• Develop and test firmware for embedded systems

• Perform component selection, testing, and validation

• Prepare technical documentation including datasheets, BOMs, and engineering specs

• Assemble and evaluate prototype boards

• Provide technical support to internal teams and customers throughout the project lifecycle

• Manage multiple cross-disciplinary engineering projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery within budget




Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electronic Engineering or related field

• 10+ years of experience in electronics design and/or technical sales engineering

• Proven track record in a customer-facing or field engineering role

• Solid knowledge of analog, digital, and embedded systems design

• Hands-on experience or working knowledge in IoT systems, PCB design using Altium Designer, and MCU programming (8051, ARM Cortex-M)

• Strong commercial acumen — comfortable managing sales cycles and technical negotiations

• Advanced English proficiency (minimum B2 level); Spanish required

• Availability to travel within Mexico and internationally, including the United States and China (valid visas are a plus but not required)

• Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders

• Self-driven, organized, and comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision




Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience
5 personal days per year (in addition to statutory vacation)
Major medical insurance (SGMM)
Gym membership support
Psychology/mental health support coverage (1 year)
Cell phone allowance (50%)

Atomic Kitchens se encuentra en búsqueda de un Ejecutivo de Ventas para impulsar el desarrollo comercial de la compañía en México, con foco en la captación, alta, activación, gestión y desarrollo de nuevos clientes en plataformas de delivery.

Esta persona será responsable de generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales, liderar el ciclo de venta completo y acompañar a cada cuenta desde su incorporación hasta su correcta activación y desarrollo operativo. Además, será responsable de gestionar y fidelizar las cuentas que sume, velando por su performance comercial y operativa dentro de las plataformas de delivery.




Principales responsabilidades

Ventas

Generar, clasificar y gestionar leads de nuevos clientes, liderando el ciclo comercial completo desde el primer contacto hasta el cierre.
Presentar la propuesta de valor de Atomic Kitchens a potenciales clientes, identificando sus necesidades y oportunidades de desarrollo dentro del ecosistema de delivery.
Gestionar el alta de restaurantes y clientes en las distintas aplicaciones de delivery, trabajando en conjunto con los ejecutivos de las plataformas para asegurar altas en tiempo y forma.
Acompañar el proceso de onboarding y los primeros días de operación, asegurando la correcta activación de la cuenta, la primera orden y una experiencia inicial positiva para el cliente.

Post Venta:

Actuar como KAM de las cuentas incorporadas, manteniendo una relación activa con los franquiciados, realizando seguimiento comercial y detectando oportunidades de mejora, expansión o reactivación.
Trabajar la performance operativa de los franquiciados incorporados, velando por el cumplimiento y mejora de métricas clave de plataformas de delivery, tales como Vendor Fail Rate, Vendor Late, rating, tiempos de preparación, cancelaciones, aceptación de órdenes y disponibilidad operativa.
Fidelizar y desarrollar la cartera de clientes incorporados, promoviendo la continuidad operativa, la satisfacción del franquiciado y el crecimiento de la cuenta.
Elaborar reportes comerciales y operativos semanales sobre leads, clientes activos, cuentas en onboarding, performance, desvíos y oportunidades de mejora, con el objetivo de planificar estratégicamente la gestión mensual.
Dar seguimiento a los KPIs de ventas, altas, activación, primera orden, retención, performance operativa y crecimiento de cuentas, proponiendo acciones para alcanzar y superar los objetivos definidos para la posición.




El candidato

• Carreras comerciales

• +4 años de experiencia en roles comerciales, desarrollo de negocios o ventas, idealmente en cadenas gastronómicas, plataformas de delivery, retail o consumo masivo

• Experiencia comprobable en captación y cierre de clientes.

• Excelentes habilidades comunicativas y de negociación.

• Manejo avanzado de paquete Office y herramientas del espacio Google.


Compentencias

Orientación al cliente
Tolerancia a la presión
Negociación
Proactividad
Planificación y organización

 

Ubicación

Ciudad de México, México 

Es excluyente que el candidato resida en México. Si bien esta posición es 100% remota, involucra reuniones presenciales con partners / proveedores y potenciales clientes a demanda.

Todo ello de la forma más sencilla e innovadora, a través de una aplicación 100% en la nube, efectiva y dinámica para el control y gestión de cualquier centro veterinario.

Gracias a ello, contamos con +1.300 centros veterinarios encantados con nuestra plataforma, y aumentando día a día. Tras consolidarnos en España, estamos lanzando Wakyma en México y Costa Rica — y buscamos a las primeras personas que nos acompañen en esta expansión.

En Wakyma nos caracterizamos por ser un equipo joven, dinámico y muy transparente. Desde el primer momento podrás entender cómo funciona todo el negocio de manera integral, trabajando en conjunto con todas las áreas de la empresa.




¿Qué buscamos?




Buscamos una persona con experiencia previa en soporte o atención al cliente (idealmente en software/SaaS), proactiva, con ganas de crecer en un entorno que te permitirá escalar y mejorar tus condiciones de acuerdo a tu rendimiento.

Una de nuestras principales fortalezas es la atención al cliente. Por eso buscamos una persona cercana, con excelentes habilidades de trato al cliente y comunicación escrita, que se sienta motivada por ofrecer a los veterinarios el mejor trato y soporte.

Serás una pieza clave en el lanzamiento de Wakyma en México: quien mejor conozca a nuestros clientes mexicanos serás tú.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? 




Brindar soporte de dudas e incidencias a los clientes de Wakyma a través de un chat online.
Realizar el seguimiento de los fallos reportados mediante gestión de tickets.
Realizar demos y videoformaciones a clientes y potenciales clientes de México y Costa Rica.
Aportar ideas para mejorar tanto nuestro producto como los procesos del departamento, con especial foco en las necesidades del mercado mexicano.
Documentar todos los procesos internos y externos.
Trabajar con CRM y herramientas del día a día como ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Holded y más.
Resolución de peticiones básicas a través del gestor de base de datos.




Requisitos




1–3 años de experiencia en soporte al cliente, idealmente en producto digital o SaaS.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, y trato directo con clientes.
Persona con iniciativa y dotes resolutivas ante cualquier problema.
Perfil tecnológico: todo lo que hacemos se basa en un entorno 100% digital.
Proactividad e iniciativa propia, para proponer ideas en el proceso de crecimiento y expansión.
Capacidad para escuchar y detectar las necesidades de los clientes.
Conexión a internet estable y equipo propio para trabajar en remoto.
RFC activo y posibilidad de emitir factura (CFDI) — esquema de honorarios / servicios profesionales.
📌 Imprescindible disponibilidad para incorporación inmediata.




Se valorará: conocimiento del sector veterinario o de salud, y experiencia con facturación electrónica (CFDI).




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




Remuneración de 1.300–1.500 USD/mes según experiencia (≈ $22.700–26.000 MXN), con pago puntual en dólares a través de plataforma de pagos internacional.
Revisión al alza tras los primeros 6 meses según rendimiento.
Contrato por prestación de servicios (honorarios) directamente con Wakyma, con vocación de relación estable y a largo plazo.
Trabajo 100% remoto desde cualquier ciudad de México.
Jornada de lunes a viernes en horario de Ciudad de México: 8:00–1pm y de 3:00pm a 6:00pm
La oportunidad de ser de las primeras personas del equipo en México, con el recorrido profesional que eso supone a medida que crezca el mercado.
Entorno startup, joven y con buen ambiente, en una empresa española en plena expansión internacional.




Si te gusta nuestro proyecto, el ambiente startup y la oportunidad de crecer con el lanzamiento de Wakyma en México, no dudes en enviarnos tu CV.

description:
About the job

Vestas LATAM North is a sales business unit covering Mexico, Caribbean, Central America and Colombia, reporting directly to our regional headquarters located in Brazil. We are responsible for the Sales function, Project, Installation and Service of wind farms throughout these regions. The Service Department at Mexico office is responsible for service, service sales and maintenance of wind turbines within such countries. As a Service Customer Support you will be part of a team consisting of 4 colleagues, where teamwork and good communication is the key.

Customer Support team is a high-profile team, working in an ever-growing business environment, with great visibility to our Customers, directing industrial in the national and international power and renewable energy business. In your role within the Customer Support team, you will play a vital part in engaging with customers and overseeing Service Contracts to ensure that performance indicators are met while also contributing to project profitability and meeting regional sales objectives.

Responsibilities:


 Develop and maintain relationships with existing customers, leveraging customer intimacy to ensure renewals of Service Contracts and secure additional business.
 Define common strategy in customer relationship management (aligned with Operation Managers).
 Assist the commercial department in the negotiation of new Service Contracts, Renewals, Settlements, Amendments and Additional Services quotations.
 Assist with answering contractual questions from Customers, Sales Department and Service Operations.
 Assure fullfilment of Service Contracts KPIs.
 Lead monthly and regular meetings with Customers, assuring compliance of contractual obligations.
 Deal with technical open cases resolution process (clear communication, regular meetings, close collaboration with Product Support, Engineering, etc.)
 Control project Billing plan including adequate invoicing of fees, variables, aftersales, bonus and penalties.
 Ensure timely collection of customer payments and assure overdues management.
 Ensure correct information in SAP and Sales Force related to the Contract.
 Responsible for contract availability monthly monitoring and negotiation with customer related to production period, supporting Service Operations.
 Maintain Monthly Reports deliveries to Customers.
 Prepare project monthly reports and present it to the board.


Qualifications:


 Engineering or Business Administration degree.


At least 3-5 years of experience in a customer-facing position (e.g. sales, project management, contract management, particularly with large complex customers) within the energy market.


 Good business sense and good economical understanding of contracts.
 Contract and Project management knowledge.
 Language skills: Spanish and English fluent, Portuguese desired.
 Wind turbine, Energy or Aircrfat industry experience would be considered.


Vacancy available for interns in Mexico

For internal candidates, you must have been in the same role and/or at Vestas for at least one year when you apply.

Location: Mexico City

Our commitment to a fair hiring.

At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement

At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

About Vestas

Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.

Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.

title: TikTok Shop Creator & Affiliate Manager
skills: Run each brand's Discord as its named voice — minimum 3 posts a week (at least one you write yourself), plus a weekly creator call breaking down the top videos and why they worked.

File one report per brand every Sunday: what's live, what's blocked, the numbers, and what you're changing.

Proven experience managing a creator community at scale (Discord or similar) as a named human, not an announcement bot — with a specific story about how you got creators to actually post.
Genuine creative instinct for short-form: you can look at a video and say why it converted.
Strong written English and the judgment to write in a brand's voice.
Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to move faster on lists, briefs, and research.
Clear, consistent communication and reliable weekly reporting.
Must be located in an EST timezone country (e.g., Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Panama) and able to overlap U.S. business hours.
Not a coordination or mass-announcement job — if your instinct on a slow week is another blast to the whole channel instead of opening DMs one at a time, this isn't the fit.
Not a role where you wait for a task list every morning — you own your brands and drive the cadence yourself.

Not measured on activity for its own sake — hitting cadence while creator volume stays flat is not success. The cadence exists to move volume, and noticing when it isn't working and changing it is part of the job.

Creator & Community Manager — TikTok Shop




This is a full-time remote role managing the creator and community side of 2–3 TikTok Shop brands for a client that runs TikTok Shop for eight-figure consumer brands. Your entire job comes down to one number: how many creators post a good video each week. You'll be the person creators know by name — telling them exactly what to make, noticing when someone goes quiet, and keeping the community energized. Someone else owns the backend, ad spend, and outreach automation; you own the relationships and the content direction. You'll work day-to-day in Reacher (or a close equivalent), TikTok Affiliate Center, Discord, Notion, and Canva.




Responsibilities
Run each brand's Discord as its named voice — minimum 3 posts a week (at least one you write yourself), plus a weekly creator call breaking down the top videos and why they worked.
Send at least one personal 1:1 message per brand per day — creators who just posted, creators close to a bonus tier, creators who've gone quiet — and give every creator who makes a good video or sale a real relationship and a Discord invite within 48 hours.
Deliver two "inspo drops" a week per brand: find the converting format (on TikTok, the brand's Meta ads, Instagram, or adjacent brands) and hand creators the hooks, scripts, and do's/don'ts — designed and digestible in Reacher or Canva, not a wall of text.
Drive creator activation: run bounties tied to specific formats, re-engage quiet creators, and work the "sampled but never posted" list every week until it shrinks.
Onboard paid and retainer creators with real energy so they understand what they signed up for and don't quietly hit the minimum — with retainer creators posting within 7 days of sample arrival.
Set brand voice and sampling direction for the approvals team, recommend where the GMV floor should sit based on real post rates, and flag broken inputs loudly and early.
File one report per brand every Sunday: what's live, what's blocked, the numbers, and what you're changing.




What We Are Looking For
Real TikTok Shop operating experience — affiliate programs, creator sampling, commission structures, and campaigns. You should be teaching us the platform, not learning it on our time.
Proven experience managing a creator community at scale (Discord or similar) as a named human, not an announcement bot — with a specific story about how you got creators to actually post.
Genuine creative instinct for short-form: you can look at a video and say why it converted.
Strong written English and the judgment to write in a brand's voice.
Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to move faster on lists, briefs, and research.
Clear, consistent communication and reliable weekly reporting.
Must be located in an EST timezone country (e.g., Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Panama) and able to overlap U.S. business hours.




Strong pluses: You've been a TikTok Shop creator yourself; existing relationships with affiliates or retainer-tier creators; experience in beauty, personal care, wellness, or supplements; on-camera comfort to make the hard video yourself when you need to prove a format works.




What the Role Is Not
Not a coordination or mass-announcement job — if your instinct on a slow week is another blast to the whole channel instead of opening DMs one at a time, this isn't the fit.
Not a role where you wait for a task list every morning — you own your brands and drive the cadence yourself.
Not measured on activity for its own sake — hitting cadence while creator volume stays flat is not success. The cadence exists to move volume, and noticing when it isn't working and changing it is part of the job.

title: Spanish Marketing Lead
skills: Marketing Launches: You'll own planning for every Spanish content release — reviewing each launch, developing a full brief with messaging direction, key audiences, channel priorities, and timelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination: You'll be the single marketing point of contact across Organic Social, Paid Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Design, and Storytelling Hacking, ensuring every team is aware of upcoming launches, is briefed, and stays on schedule. You’ll review video ad scripts and creative for Paid..

Content Positioning & Trend Spotting: You'll track Catholic news, the liturgical calendar, and social trends across Latin America and the Spanish-speaking world, turning what you find into concrete recommendations you execute on. You'll find fresh angles that make releases land with Spanish-speaking audiences, from liturgical-calendar tie-ins and seasonal hooks to relaunching existing content into new campaigns.

Localizing Marketing: You’ll localize any necessary marketing assets (e.g., push and email campaigns, landing pages, video ad scripts, etc.) to ensure assets are finalized and scheduled in time for launches.
Experimentation: You'll design tests on messaging, creative, timing, and segmentation, then partner with Performance Marketing to apply learnings to future releases.

Partner Relationships: As needed you’ll help source and serve as the first point of contact with new marketing partners, managing these relationships and negotiations end-to-end. For our largest partnerships, you’ll attend recordings in person and help direct video ad production to ensure the highest output quality.

Mission: This work is incredibly humbling. Every day we hear amazing stories and we get the pleasure of working on something that's impacting lives. One of our favorite user quotes: "I hate quoting an old, overused cliche, but I've been very lost. And I think for the first time in a while I may be found."
Ownership: You'll be the single point of accountability for how new content reaches Latin America — from the first brief to the final push notification.
Growth: From day 1, you'll be a part of the startup journey — helping build the international marketing playbook as Hallow's LATAM presence scales.

Flexibility: We’re looking for a candidate who is based anywhere in Latin America. This role may require some late night or early morning work to maximize overlap with the U.S. Central Time Zone, plus some travel for partnerships and recordings.
Comp: We will pay competitive market rates in terms of equity, cash, & benefits.
Passion: First & foremost, we're looking for someone excited about our mission. It makes it a lot more fun :)
Cross-Functional Operator: You're comfortable coordinating across cross-functional teams and across global time zones, without letting details slip.
Culturally Fluent: You have a strong pulse on Latin American culture and trends — familiarity with the Catholic liturgical calendar and devotional practices across the region is a big plus.
Analytical & Curious: You know how to read and communicate about Marketing Performance metrics. You have a sharp analytical mindset and genuine curiosity about audience behavior and experimentation.

Experience: You have 4-6+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, or Brand Marketing. You have native or near-native proficiency in Spanish and professional proficiency in English; Portuguese is a plus. You've worked on mobile app marketing or lifecycle marketing before.
description:
About the job

Who We Are

Hallow is on a mission to help people pray. We’re the No. 1 prayer app in the world, with more than 1 billion prayers prayed across 150+ countries. We're building a product that is authentically Christian and Catholic, while at the same time a resource for anyone looking to grow deeper in a relationship with God. We believe that people are hungry for peace, and that there is no surer way to find it than by learning to sit in silence with Christ: “Come to me, all you that are weary and are carrying heavy burdens, and I will give you rest” (Mt 11:28).

Our goal is to build something truly great. Something that combines the beauty of the Church's spirituality with world-class product and content execution. And we need a world-class team to make it happen.

We launched the app in December 2018 and have been blown away with the incredible growth & traction. Hallow has been downloaded more than 30 million times with over 250,000 5-star reviews. We're blessed to be backed by some of the best mission-driven investors in the world and are excited to build out the team to help a lot more folks grow closer to God.

We are a startup. We move quickly. We are small but we take big swings. Each person is responsible for making an impact. It is hard—but deeply meaningful—work. We'd be honored & humbled if you'd consider joining us.

Analizar el desempeño del funnel completo: impresión, clic, visita, interacción, lead, cotización y conversión.
Identificar causas de incrementos en CPA o CPL, caídas de volumen, pérdida de calidad de tráfico o desviaciones presupuestales.

Proponer redistribuciones presupuestales basadas en eficiencia, volumen, saturación, demanda e inventario.
Documentar optimizaciones y medir su impacto.
Creación de diversos reportes generados de forma manual y semiautomatizada.

Recomendar presupuesto por marca, modelo, objetivo, plataforma, audiencia y etapa del funnel.
Administrar pacing diario, semanal y mensual.
Detectar riesgos de subejercicio y sobreejercicio.
Construir escenarios de inversión y forecast.
Analizar capacidad de entrega, tamaño de audiencia, match rate, frecuencia y saturación.
Validar cumplimiento contra plan, objetivo y proyección.

Preparar análisis ejecutivos por marca, modelo, plataforma, campaña, objetivo y periodo.
Transformar datos de campaña en recomendaciones accionables.
Identificar tendencias, anomalías, correlaciones y oportunidades de negocio.
Comparar desempeño contra periodos anteriores, benchmarks, plan y forecast.

Construir y revisar dashboards en Power BI, Looker Studio o herramientas equivalentes.
Construir Modelados de Datos avanzados, Concatenaciones y programación en DAX.

Presentar resultados ante cliente, directores de marca y equipos senior.

Revisar píxeles, eventos estándar, eventos personalizados, conversiones y parámetros dinámicos.
Supervisar el cumplimiento de implementación de CAPI CRM, CAPI WEB, ECT (Enhance Conversión Tracking) y sistemas de 1FPD
Supervisar UTMs, taxonomías, nomenclaturas y trazabilidad de campañas.
Colaborar en implementaciones de Meta Conversion API y Google Enhanced Conversions.
Detectar pérdida de señal, duplicidad de eventos, errores de firing y diferencias de atribución.
Validar eventos de lead, cotización, visita a distribuidor, interacción con inventario y páginas de modelo.
Apoyar procesos de debugging y documentación de medición.
Diferenciar correctamente entre clics, sesiones, usuarios, eventos y conversiones.

Diseñar estrategias de prospecting, remarketing y retención.
Administrar audiencias first-party provenientes de CRM, bases de datos y comportamiento digital.
Evaluar match rate, tamaño, calidad y ventana de retención de las audiencias.
Construir audiencias de visitantes por modelo, distribuidores, inventario, VDP, formularios y cotizadores.
Desarrollar lookalikes y audiencias similares.
Trabajar con audiencias in-market, custom intent, video viewers y engagement.
Definir exclusiones y controles para evitar duplicidad, desperdicio o saturación.
Justificar técnicamente el uso de cada audiencia dentro del funnel.
Pruebas A/B y experimentación:
Diseñar agendas de prueba para audiencia, creatividad, oferta, formato, placement, formulario, landing page y optimización.
Construir hipótesis, controles, variables y criterios de éxito.
Definir inversión mínima, duración y KPI principal.
Analizar resultados sin generar conclusiones prematuras.
Recomendar escalamiento, iteración o descarte.
Documentar aprendizajes para futuras campañas.

Mínimo +10 años de experiencia en marketing digital, paid media, performance marketing o analítica digital.
Mínimo 6 años liderando cuentas complejas o portafolios multicanal.
Experiencia operando presupuestos relevantes en Meta, Google, YouTube y plataformas programáticas.
Experiencia trabajando campañas de awareness, tráfico, generación de leads y conversión.
Experiencia con múltiples campañas, modelos, audiencias y objetivos activos simultáneamente.
Experiencia en industrias de alta consideración, preferentemente automotriz, financiero, inmobiliario, telecomunicaciones o productos de alto valor.
Experiencia presentando resultados ante directores, clientes senior o equipos regionales.
Experiencia supervisando especialistas de medios, analítica y operación.
Experiencia en Business Analytics, Data Sciene y Modelados de Datos AO
Conocimientos técnicos indispensables:
Plataformas de medios: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, DV360, Search Ads 360, Campaign Manager 360, Amazon Ads, Linkedin Ads, X Ads.
Analítica y medición: Adobe Launch, Shopify API, AEM, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Conversion API, Google Ads Conversion

Data y business intelligence: Excel avanzado, Power Query, Power Pivot, Power BI, Fabric, Modelado de datos, DAX, Tablas de hechos y dimensiones, Relaciones entre fuentes, Homologación de catálogos, Forecast, Análisis de variaciones, Automatización de reportes, Integración de bases de campañas y leads.

Performance marketing: CPA, CPL, CPC, CPM, CTR, Tasa de conversión, Pacing, Forecasting, Funnel analysis, MQL, SQL, %Viewability, %Authentic Rate, Incrementalidad, Audiencias first-party, Lookalikes, Remarketing, Frequency management, Creative fatigue, Conversion rate optimization, Testing frameworks, etc.

Inglés avanzado indispensable (Profesional B2, C1)

About the job

GoPancham | Full-time | Daily overlap with US/Canada hours

Compensation: $23,500 – $45,000/yr USD (base + retention bonus + commission)

This isn’t a “check in and relay updates” role. It’s strategic growth, and your clients stay because of you.




About GoPancham

GoPancham is an Inc. 5000 agency helping fitness businesses grow through paid social on Meta, Google & YouTube. 200+ active clients, 700+ businesses served, 50+ team members worldwide, 7+ years running.




About the Role

This is not a media buying role. We have a dedicated team for that. You’ll own a portfolio of fitness business owners as their primary strategic partner. A separate team of media buyers, creative strategists, and designers handles all campaign execution. Your job is the client relationship, not the ad account: turning their data into direction and making every client feel like they have a real growth partner in their corner.




What You’ll Do

You’ll own your book of clients, with retention as a direct reflection of how you manage it. You’ll run structured strategy calls back-to-back without losing context between them, and turn Meta and Google performance data into clear direction clients trust without needing to run the campaigns yourself. You’ll build 6–12 month growth strategies rather than weekly check-ins, spot retention risk before it becomes a cancellation, and collaborate daily with media buyers, creatives, and designers without being one of them.




Who This Role Is NOT For

This isn’t for someone whose experience is running ad accounts or campaigns without owning the client relationship. That’s our media buying team’s job, not this one. It’s also not for candidates coming from ticket-based customer support with no strategic marketing input, anyone who waits for clients to raise concerns before acting, or anyone who needs step-by-step instructions for every situation. If “checking in” is your idea of account management, this isn’t the role.




What We’re Looking For
Portfolio ownership: 3+ years as the named point of contact for a real client portfolio, not executing marketing tasks or tickets behind the scenes
Marketing knowledge: Deep enough to lead a strategic client conversation with confidence, even without hands-on campaign execution
Proven track record: Real numbers on accounts managed and retention achieved
Time management: Strong ability to run back-to-back client calls without losing the thread
Communication: A confident communicator clients genuinely trust
Availability: Full-time, with real daily overlap on US/Canada hours

Nice to have: Agency background (multi-client portfolios over in-house), CRM familiarity (GoHighLevel/HubSpot), fitness industry experience.




What Success Looks Like
Retention: Clients stay because they trust the direction you’re giving them
Portfolio health: A full book managed without dropping context or losing ground on any account
Strategic trust: Clients treat you as their growth partner, not a status-update relay




How to Apply

Apply by filling out the form here:

https://hiring.kickstartmyfitnessjourney.com/client-strategy-manager-mx

When you apply, be ready to talk numbers: how many accounts you’ve owned and what your retention rate looked like. No script, no fluff. Just your track record.

description:
About the job

Remote | Full-Time Contract | United States or Latin America




$2,500–$4,000 USD/month | 40 hours/week




Are you the person who notices the typo everyone else missed? Do broken links, inconsistent branding, awkward copy, or a button that doesn’t work immediately catch your attention?

We’re looking for a Marketing QA Specialist to be the final set of eyes on client-facing marketing work before it goes live.




You’ll review everything from landing pages and paid ads to SEO content and videos, making sure the finished product is accurate, polished, functional, and ready for the client.

This isn’t primarily a design or copywriting position. You won’t be expected to create everything yourself. Instead, you’ll help make sure the work our teams create meets the standard our clients expect.




What You’ll Do

You’ll work across several areas of digital marketing and collaborate with SEO, paid media, creative, web, and video teams. Your responsibilities will include:

Reviewing landing pages for spelling, grammar, layout, functionality, branding, and overall quality
Testing links, buttons, forms, phone numbers, calls to action, and mobile responsiveness
Reviewing paid advertising copy for accuracy, clarity, formatting, messaging, and alignment with client offers
Checking SEO content and on-page assets for readability, professionalism, and client requirements
Reviewing client videos for visual and audio quality, captions, branding, messaging, transitions, and calls to action
Comparing completed work against briefs, brand guidelines, approved messaging, and client feedback
Catching inconsistencies, missing information, unsupported claims, and other issues before they reach the client
Giving clear, actionable feedback so teams know exactly what needs to be corrected
Tracking revisions and confirming corrections have been completed before final approval
Maintaining QA checklists and helping identify recurring quality issues




You’ll Be a Great Fit If...

You have an eye for details that other people tend to miss, but you can also explain why something needs to be fixed.

We’re looking for someone with excellent written and spoken English, strong grammar and communication skills, and experience reviewing digital marketing assets, websites, content, creative work, or other client-facing deliverables.

You should be comfortable working with several projects and deadlines at once, giving constructive feedback, and working independently in a remote environment.

Familiarity with SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, landing pages, websites, and marketing videos is especially valuable.




Experience with tools such as ClickUp, Slack, and Google Workspace, structured QA processes, or conversion-focused landing pages is a plus.




What Success Looks Like

You’re catching mistakes before the client does.

Client-facing work consistently looks polished and professional, teams receive feedback they can act on quickly, and reviews are completed on time without slowing down production.

Over time, you’ll also help identify patterns and recurring issues so we can improve the process—not just fix the same mistakes again and again.

Schedule & Compensation




This is a full-time contract position working 40 hours per week. Your eight-hour daily schedule will fall within the 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Central Time business window.




The position is fully remote and open to qualified candidates located in the United States or Latin America.




Compensation: $2,500–$4,000 USD per month, based on experience and qualifications.




Ready to Apply?

We’d love to hear from people who genuinely enjoy finding the little things that make a big difference.




When applying, tell us a little about your experience reviewing marketing, creative, web, or client-facing work—and what makes you great at catching issues before they become problems.
